discovery.headline: Jansen & Daughters ranks 13th for this crowd and 26th for the room's usual crowd.
discovery.detail: Bars and record stores are the most common types on the list (6 of 24 each); this one is a restaurant in Nashville-Davidson, 17 km west. Ask to leave flyers at the counter.
discovery.rule: the best-scoring partner in a top area that isn't the most common type on the list and that the room's usual crowd ranks at least 5 places lower, or not at all. Walkup tries the area rule first; no numbered area met it on this sheet.
